item.title: Evening Weather for Sunday, August 23
item.description: Good evening! It's the weekend. No school today! Let's find out what the weather is like on this Sunday, August 23. It's Sunday, a good day to rest and get ready for the week. In Shanghai today, expect it to be rumbling with thunderstorms. It will reach 31 degrees, and drop down to 27 degrees. The chance of rain is 99 percent. Remember to take an umbrella with you! Watch out for snails after the rain. They love wet weather! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be drizzly, with a high of 32 degrees. Think about this one: what is the funniest sound you can make? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
